comment.body:
Thanks for specifying the three monitors and elevation. Selecting text from the screen after activation sounds more like Text Extractor than Advanced Paste, so we should identify the actual tool before changing its positioning.
1. Which exact shortcut do you press, and which tool name or selection UI appears? A screenshot over non-sensitive test text would help.
2. Please show the Windows Display arrangement and the resolution/scale of monitors 2 and 3. That distinguishes a capture-coordinate mismatch from an ordinary popup appearing on another monitor.
